name: nocoos
description: NocoOS — a complete Node.js desktop operating environment with virtual filesystem, window manager, terminal, and package installer.

scripts.test:unit: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/config.test.js tests/registry.test.js tests/lock.test.js tests/session.test.js tests/parser.test.js tests/port-finder.test.js tests/terminal.test.js tests/logger.test.js tests/metrics.test.js tests/package-manager.test.js tests/kernel.test.js tests/hmr-syntax.test.js tests/lint-and-hmr.test.js tests/multi-instance.test.js tests/client-errors.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:backend && pnpm run test:e2e:frontend
scripts.test:all: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e
